definitions.explanation: The unit of reproduction in plants.
The origin or cause of something.
Subject matter for discussion or creation.

examples.english: To become a source of worry.

notes:
{種|たね} has both literal and figurative meanings.

LITERAL:
- {種|たね}を{蒔|ま}く: to sow seeds
- {種|たね}を{取|と}る: to save seeds

FIGURATIVE:
- {話|はなし}の{種|たね}: topic of conversation
- {笑|わら}いの{種|たね}: source of laughter
- {心配|しんぱい}の{種|たね}: cause of worry
